title: Show Wiring (Spring4D DI + DFM events)
summary: Surfaces bindings the compiler does not make obvious: Spring4D container registrations and DFM event hookups for a type
intro: Read this when you are tracing how an interface gets resolved or which handler a DFM event really calls: it shows the Spring4D container registrations and DFM event hookups the compiler does not make obvious.

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Uses & Dependencies > Show Wiring (Spring4D DI + DFM events)...
steps: Open the unit that declares the type
Choose drag-lint > Uses & Dependencies > Show Wiring (Spring4D DI + DFM events)...
Read the container registrations and DFM event hookups for the type
From a shell: drag-lint wiring --qname <IIntf|TForm> [--db <file.sqlite>] [--format text|json]

surfaces.usage: drag-lint wiring --qname <IIntf|TForm> [--db <file.sqlite>] [--format text|json] (Spring4D DI + DFM event edges)
help: drag-lint wiring             --qname <IIntf|TForm> [--db <file.sqlite>] [--format text|json]   (Spring4D DI + DFM event edges)
drag-lint wiring             --coverage           [--db <file.sqlite>] [--format text|json]   (DI registrations not resolved to I->T)

questions.ask: Where is this interface registered in the Spring4D container?
Which DFM event handlers are hooked up for this form?
